FULL TEXT:
Notification
District Health Society, Krishnagiri
Applications are invited from eligible candidates for engagement of Staff
Nurses on Contract basis purely temporary in nature, as per NHM norms in the
Comprehensive Emergency Obstetric and Newborn Care(CEmONC) institutions
including the Special Newborn Care units (SNCU) and Paediatric Intensive Care
Units(PICU) under Krishnagiri Medical college and Hospitals and Government Hospitals.
Applications should reach the Krishnagiri District Health Office on or before 04.12.2026
at 5:00 PM.

Terms and conditions
1. The Engagement is purely temporary on contract basis under NHM and shall not
confer any right to claim regularization. Selected candidates will be placed, as
per G.O.(Ms).No 427 Health and Family welfare EAP-II/1 Department,
dated:18.11.2026
2. To know the complete details regarding the above-mentioned vacancy, please
visit the official website of Krishnagiri District (https://krishnagiri.nic.in/).
3. The application form can be downloaded from the "Recruitment" section of the
Krishnagiri District website. (https://krishnagiri.nic.in/) and also in NHM
website(https://nhm.tn.gov.in)
4. The Number of vacancies is subject to change
Note:
• Applications are invited in person or via Speed Post..
• Photocopies of all the following certificates must be attached to the application
for the above-mentioned posts.
• Please note that applications submitted without attaching Photo copies of the
following certificates will be rejected.
1. Proof of Date of Birth – Birth Certificate / SSLC / HSC Certificate
2. Educational Qualification and Mark Sheet – SSLC, HSC, DGNM /
B.Sc., Nursing Certificate.
3. Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council Registration Certificate
and also renewal Certificate if eligible.
4. Proof of Tamil Eligibility – 10th or 12th Standard Mark sheet
5. Proof Residence – any one of the following
• Voter ID
• Aadhaar Card
• Ration Card
6. Character and Conduct Certificate issued by a Group A or Group B
Government Officer, dated within the last 3 months.
7. Any other Certificate relevant to the applicable scoring criteria,
wherever applicable.
8. Two Recent Passport – Size colour photographs
9. Community Certificate.
The Address the application to be sent:-
The Secretary / District Health Officer,
District Collectorate Back Side, Near Regional Transport Office (RTO),
Ramapuram Post, Krishnagiri District - 635 115.
District Health Officer (i/c), Chairman/District Collector,
District Health Society, District Health Society,
Krishnagiri District. Krishnagiri District.
